name: Arch Boyd
role: Manager of the Pyramid Park and Northern Pacific hotels
bio: Arch Boyd took over the Pyramid Park hotel at Little Missouri in September 1884, at first as Boyd & Alexander, and ran it alone after the partnership dissolved that November, hosting well-attended dances. In March 1885 he leased Medora's new hotel, and by June he and his wife were running the Northern Pacific hotel to wide praise. In May 1886 the paper stated that only one shot had been fired in the hotel since he assumed its management. He gave up the hotel at the end of November 1886, and in December he and his wife left for Minot.
